title: JPMorgan says a 2026 blue wave could slam AI data center stocks that now make up 45% of the S&P 500
key_facts: JPMorgan strategist Dubravko Lakos-Bujas wrote a note on strategies by midterm outcome.
Polymarket estimates an 85% chance of a Democratic 'blue wave' (218 House seats, 49 Senate seats).
AI stocks are 45% of S&P 500 market cap, per the article.
Lakos-Bujas: Republican control would likely give the most supportive federal policy backdrop for AI infrastructure.
A Republican Senate committee memo calls data centers a 'sleeper issue' in the election.
Many voters worry about data center cost and environmental impact.
quote_evidence: If Republicans maintain control of Congress, that would likely provide the most supportive incremental federal policy backdrop for the AI/Infrastructure buildout, wrote Lakos-Bujas.
AI stocks make up 45% of the S&P 500 market cap.
why_it_matters_hint: Links the AI stock rally to US election risk.
notes: Article originally on Moneywise.com, carried by Yahoo Finance. Read in full; article also contains unrelated personal-finance promotions that are ignored.
